programme.desc: A successful man tries to reconnect with his old teacher only to find out that she is in deep trouble. Upon learning this, he decides to do everything he can to save her.

programme.title: Super Shastri
programme.desc: Subramanya, son of a Brahmin priest, falls in love with Sowmya, the daughter of a village criminal. To impress her family, Subramanya decides to become a gangster.

programme.title: Prithipal Singh...A Story
programme.desc: Disappointed with his Olympic bronze medal, Prithipal Singh quits hockey and joins a university. However, things get worse for him when he is accused of murdering a student.

programme.title: Samay-when the time strikes
programme.desc: ACP Malvika Chauhan, a widowed mother, is assigned to investigate the murder of a businessman. However, she suspects it to be a serial killer as more murders take place in the city.

programme.title: Katilon Ke Kaatil
programme.desc: A wealthy widow meets Munna and Ajit and assumes them to be her estranged sons. She takes them into her house, unaware that their intentions are to loot her entire wealth.

programme.title: Krantiveer
programme.desc: After being disowned by his family, Pratap, a juvenile gambler, ends up in Mumbai where he gets adopted by Laxminath, a landlord. However, when Laxminath is murdered, Pratap vows to avenge him.

programme.title: Guddu Ki Gun
programme.desc: Guddu, a salesman, lands in dire trouble when his girlfriend's grandfather casts a spell on him for cheating on her. However, he must find true love to get rid of the curse.

programme.title: Ek Aur Hero The Dashing
programme.desc: After the death of their eldest brother, Babloo and the other three brothers develop hatred towards women. However, things take a turn when Babloo falls in love with Pooja.

programme.title: Humse Hai Zamana
programme.desc: Ravindra and Gowri, who belong to rival factions, are sworn enemies. After being imprisoned and learning that his brother was killed, Gowri goes after Ravindra's sister, Preeti, as revenge.

programme.title: Naya Din Nayi Raat
programme.desc: Sushma, a young girl, runs away from home to escape an arranged marriage. On her way, she meets many people, each representing a distinct facet of human nature, who help her in her difficulties.

programme.title: Dhongee
programme.desc: Chandran lies to his boss that his mother is unwell to get a leave but gets caught. In order to save his job, he is forced to pretend to his boss that he has a good-for-nothing twin brother.

programme.title: 16 December
programme.desc: Four Indian Revenue Service officers are assigned to intercept and arrest a group of Pakistani terrorists. The terrorists plot to detonate a nuclear bomb in New Delhi and the IRS must stop them.

programme.title: Hiraasat
programme.desc: ACP Ashok Saxena is an honest middle-class police officer who lives with his wife, Shobha, and college-going brother, Rajesh. However, he is framed in a case of drug-trafficking and gets arrested.

programme.desc: Dressed Up For The Holidays. Ree Drummond celebrates the holidays with special seasonal eats. For brunch, there's smoked salmon Benedict, and an elegant creamy mushroom soup. S26, Ep2

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James visits the Dordogne, known for its hearty cuisine. He tastes three local specialities and seeks out the region's local icon, black truffle! S1, Ep5

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: The Final. Paul and Prue set three challenges that test every aspect of the bakers' skills. After tackling a tough technical, the bakers must create a deceptive picnic basket feast. S10, Ep10

programme.title: Mary Berry - Love To Cook
programme.desc: For Family & Friends. Mary steps out with her daughter Annabel, who shares her love of cooking in the open, whilst rustling up her best comfort food recipes. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Jamie's Air-Fryer Meals
programme.desc: Jamie Oliver shares his easy and inventive air-fryer recipes for beginners and beyond, from fuss-free midweek meals to impressive desserts. S1, Ep2

programme.title: New: Chopped Castaways
programme.desc: You're On Your Own, Kid. The chefs must navigate the dense jungle with only a compass to locate their baskets. In round one, each chef is pushed to define their point of view. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Flavortown Flavorfest. Guy Fieri's diving into lights-out lasagne in California, a prime-time pork burger in Cincinnati and killer coconut escolar ceviche in Austin, TX. S42, Ep3

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Soup, Salad and Sorbet Spins. Guy Fieri's sampling carnitas ramen in Austin, TX, prime-time pulled pork poutine in Cincinnati, and sorbet with a tom-yum twist in Los Angeles. S42, Ep4

programme.title: PL Greatest: Coventry/Man Utd 1997

programme.title: PL Greatest:Everton/Wimbledon 1994
programme.desc: Everton: Enjoy the greatest Premier League game for each of the league's 47 clubs, as voted for by fans. For Everton, the 3-2 win over Wimbledon in 1994 that ensured the Toffees' survival.

programme.title: PL Greatest: Man City/Fulham 2008
programme.desc: Fulham: Enjoy the greatest Premier League game for each of the league's 47 clubs, as voted for by fans. For Fulham, the 3-2 fightback at Man City in 2008 that ignited their survival run.

programme.title: PL Greatest: M'boro/Man City 2008
programme.desc: Middlesbrough: Enjoy the greatest Premier League game for each of the league's 49 clubs, as voted for by fans. Here, for Middlesbrough, the 8-1 hammering of Man City back in May 2008.

programme.title: ICC Women's T20 WC Highlights
programme.desc: Ireland meet the West Indies in Bristol during the group stage of the ICC Women's T20 World Cup. (27.06)

programme.title: ICC Women's T20 WC Highlights

programme.title: ATP Final: Stuttgart
programme.desc: Defending champion Taylor Fritz plays Ben Shelton in an all-American title decider on the grass of Stuttgart. (14.06)

programme.title: LET Hlts: Aramco C'Ship USA
programme.desc: Tournament highlights from the 2026 Aramco Championship, a Ladies European Tour event staged at Shadow Creek Golf Course in Nevada. Spain's Nuria Iturrioz scooped last year's prize.

programme.title: US Open Golf Day 2 Highlights

programme.title: WTA Final: Hamburg
programme.desc: A women's singles champion is crowned in Hamburg.
